data_sources: CNINFO/company IR/exchange official filings for source-of-truth facts
AkShare and market snapshots only for discovery, cross-check and explicit gaps
No price level is used to select or rank companies
field_requirements: Identity, scope, unit, period, source URL, original-file hash and parser version
Model-specific facts must satisfy the registered ValuationModel facts contract
Assumptions must be bounded, evidenced and bound to actual scenario inputs

allowed_new_company_workstreams: W3 first six readable research dossiers

stop_rules: Stop adding companies when the registered list reaches 20
Pause a company when its material model/data blocker remains unresolved after three evidence attempts
Never overwrite the frozen three-company manifest or production workbook
Never fabricate a READY state to meet a company-count target
acceptance_criteria: At least six readable dossiers with evidence, counter-evidence, breakers and next events
Unsupported, insufficient and negative cases remain visible as non-READY
All results preserve action=no_order and human confirmation boundaries
